Solution 1's answer, (d-1)/2, gives 1/2 in d=2. The planar theory for finite-distortion mappings points to an integrability threshold of 1 there, which rules it out. Solutions 2 and 3 both give 1 in d=2, so the d=2 check does not separate them. I chose Solution 2, d(d-1)/2, because I recall this exponent from the recent literature on sharp integrability for nonuniformly elliptic nondivergence equations. I could not verify that recollection, and the reasoning in Solution 2 is heuristic, so my confidence is moderate.
